correctness.rationale: An exact 3x3 orthogonal frame gives weighted-cosine Frobenius square 1800677/320013, exceeding the conjectured 945/169 by the positive rational 1902128/54082197. A block-diagonal construction yields a strictly positive factored gap in every dimension n>=3. A separate frame-operator argument proves the conjectured cross-frame inequality for n=2, with n=1 trivial.

originality.rationale: The 2026 source preprint explicitly presents the weighted-cosine Frobenius inequality as a conjecture. Searches of weighted-cosine, singular-vector-coherence, Hadamard-frame, fixed-spectrum correlation-matrix, and orthogonal-orbit formulations found no prior source giving the exact dimension threshold, the counterexample family, or the dimension-four separation from a real Hadamard frame. Originality is asserted only to the best of our knowledge.

value.rationale: The result resolves a stated conjecture, identifies its exact dimensional validity boundary, and shows that the Hadamard stationary/equal-diagonal frame can fail global optimality even in order four, while preserving a sharp positive theorem in dimensions one and two.
